messages:
Maya: deploy-bot just opened an alert — canary for model inference v2.2.0 is showing a correctness regression on embedding vectors (similarity drift). p95 latency fine, but eval set MAP dropped ~8% vs baseline. thinking manual rollback to v2.1.3 for canary traffic. opinions?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary: model=v2.2.0 region=usw2 metric=embedding_map drop=8.3% p95_latency=120ms threshold=5% automated_rollback=disabled

Cheng: thanks. can you paste the failing eval snippet and recent canary split? need to know blast radius — is dedicated traffic affected or just hosted?

Maya: canary split is 5% overall; no dedicated customers on v2.2.0 yet. failing eval is in thread_similarity suite, quick sample below:
```
input: "compare user query to doc"
baseline_top1: doc-123
v2.2.0_top1: doc-789
similarity_score_drop: 0.18 -> 0.09
```

Sam H: +1 for manual revert on canary. since automated_rollback is disabled, do a controlled rollback: pin canary to v2.1.3, run smoke eval, then allow gradual re-rollout after signoff. keep support looped.

Lisa: support & sales notified? I can send customer-facing note if any self-serve customers hit regressions. Also add a short blurb to release notes about reverting v2.2.0 canary due to quality regression.

Maya: I'm going to execute the rollback now. Cheng, can you coordinate the smoke eval once traffic is pinned? Here's the pin command from runbook:
```
# pin canary traffic back to v2.1.3
rdctl rollout set --model my-embed --from v2.2.0 --to v2.1.3 --scope canary --reason "canary quality regression"
```

Cheng: copying runbook steps. will run smoke eval (thread_similarity, ranking_smoke) and post results in 10m. if smoke passes, we'll keep v2.1.3 on canary and open a follow-up to investigate v2.2.0.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollback initiated by Maya. action_id=rb-1991234567 status=started

Maya: FYI I asked infra to hold any simultaneous GC changes — want to reduce confounding factors.

Sam H: once smoke eval results are in, we'll notify eng-ml and schedule a focused postmortem. Sam/Cheng can lead.

Lisa: sent initial note to #support with expected window ~15m, and to sales with a heads-up for any enterprise customers. cc: @security if needed.

Cheng: smoke eval results: embedding_map restored to +0.2% vs baseline, ranking_smoke good. no error spike.

Maya: great — rollback successful. deploy-bot, mark action_id=rb-1991234567 status=completed. I'll create a short follow-up ticket to triage v2.2.0 diffs and add to next sprint.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollback completed action_id=rb-1991234567 status=success duration=4m32s

Sam H: adding checklist for future: enable automated_rollback for regression thresholds or add model-level preflight eval to avoid next time.

Maya: agreed. will add to postmortem: improve canary eval coverage, consider auto-pin for quality drops >3%.

Lisa: drafting customer-facing blurb for release notes and support KB. will drop link once ready. :memo:

Maya: thanks everyone — closing thread after ticket created.
